title: NCP-ArchPreview：通过下一概念预测迈向潜在空间语言模型
summary: 提出NCP-ArchPreview潜在空间语言模型，在标准下一词预测之外引入下一概念预测（NCP），通过乘积量化构建概念词汇表并预测跨多词的概念。模型扩展至89亿参数，仅用51.3%训练token即达到OLMo-3-7B的预训练损失，下游宏平均提升2.45分，GSM8K提升5.99分。
summary_en: Introduces NCP-ArchPreview, a latent-space language model that augments next-token prediction with Next Concept Prediction (NCP), predicting discrete multi-token concepts via a product-quantized concept vocabulary. Scaled to 8.9B parameters, it matches OLMo-3-7B's pretraining loss using only 51.3% of tokens and outperforms it by 2.45 points downstream, including +5.99 on GSM8K.
